home.headline: Warm bread, every morning, a few steps from the lake road.
home.intro: Furra Gjoni is a family bakery and café in the old centre of Shkodër. We bake in the same wood-fired oven Gjon Gjoni built in 1987, and we open the doors at half past six so the first loaves are still warm when you walk in.

menu.title: Menu
menu.intro: Everything is baked on the premises. Prices are in lek and include tax. Order a whole loaf or a tray by phone before 18:00 and we will have it ready at six-thirty the next morning.

about.title: Our story
paragraphs: Gjon Gjoni opened the bakery in 1987 with one oven, a rented counter and a sack of flour his brother carried over from Lezhë. The oven is still the heart of the place.
Today his daughter Mira runs the front and the books, and his grandson Luka keeps the oven fire going before dawn. Drita, who joined in 1994, makes every tray of sweets by hand.
We use flour from mills in the Mat valley, butter from a dairy near Koplik, and honey from hives above Boga. We do not use improvers or pre-made dough.
facts: Wood-fired oven, lit at 4:30 each morning
Nine tables inside, four on the pavement in summer
Free Wi-Fi, high chairs and a step-free entrance

contactPage.title: Find us
contactPage.intro: We are on the pedestrian street between the old market and the lake road. Look for the green door and the smell of bread.
contactPage.directions: From the main square, walk down Rruga Kolë Idromeno for two minutes. We are on the left, opposite the pharmacy.
contactPage.ordering: Whole loaves, byrek trays and cakes can be ordered by phone or email. Orders for the next morning close at 18:00.
